items.text: Model SIP installments as repeated subscriptions with independent payment outcomes and allotment NAV; missed installments must stay missed.
evidence: kernel/mf_sip.py models independent immutable SIP installment outcomes and a per-installment state machine; MISSED is terminal, and successful allotment requires distinct payment and NAV clocks plus unit/NAV reconciliation.
paper/mf_sip_book.py and mf_paper_sip_* schema tables persist schedules and installment transitions independently and idempotently; restart tests verify missed status survives database reopen.
Tests verify one installment can progress while a missed neighbor stays unchanged, missed installments cannot be retried, duplicate plan IDs cannot rewrite schedules, and event time is not backdated.

advance_installment() now reserves each cleared installment by reducing available paper cash and posting CASH to SIP_PAYMENT_PENDING in the balanced journal; simulated assumptions are labeled, observed payment evidence requires effective PAPER_SIMULATION permission, and missed installments do not reserve cash.

apply_sip_allotment() requires the exact persisted NAV observation available at decision time plus effective AMFI PAPER_SIMULATION permission; it atomically consumes the reserve into the MF investment journal, creates one FIFO lot, and records ALLOTTED. Missing source publication timestamps remain NULL rather than inferred.
Observed payment receipts retain source identity, reference, SHA-256 and effective PAPER_SIMULATION permission; replay with changed receipt evidence is rejected.

Each SIP allotment now requires a persisted MF paper order in ACCEPTED state whose account, folio, scheme, plan, option, type and amount match the installment; acceptance effective/receipt times and receipt hash come from the append-only order transition, not caller-supplied timestamps.

The eligible NAV date is derived from max(accepted-order effective time, cleared-funds time) using the effective, already-published scheme purchase rule and source-bounded scheme calendar; the API accepts no caller-selected NAV date.

Allotment requires the exact persisted NAV for that derived date, available by the decision time, plus AMFI PAPER_SIMULATION permission. After-cutoff payment cannot use the earlier date; unavailable/unpublished NAV leaves the installment unallotted and the cash reserve intact. The order, payment, NAV, lot, unit and ledger clocks are preserved; missing provider publication time remains NULL.

MISSED remains terminal. Cleared payment is journaled into SIP_PAYMENT_PENDING; accepted-order-linked allotment atomically consumes that reserve into MF investment cost, creates the fractional FIFO lot, and records ALLOTTED. Crash retry and source-evidence mutation are covered.

items.text: Distinguish order accepted, working, partial fill, cancelled, rejected, missed, timed out and unknown outcome; never synthesize missing fills.
evidence: The append-only order journal now distinguishes CREATED, SUBMITTED, ACCEPTED, WORKING, PARTIAL, FILLED, CANCEL_PENDING, CANCELED, REJECTED, MISSED, TIMED_OUT, UNKNOWN and EXPIRED with explicit legal transitions, including fills that race a cancel request.

The ForwardSessionRunner persists order events in the same SQLite journal as its durable outbox and paper receipts. Intents record CREATED/SUBMITTED; successful receipts record PARTIAL/FILLED/MISSED/REJECTED; a durable outbox exception or restart records UNKNOWN. Session records return the canonical per-order event trace.

Resume reconstructs a missing terminal event only from an already DISPATCHED outbox and its hashed durable receipt. It never turns a PENDING/UNKNOWN key into a fill; receipt-based effect reconciliation or explicit no-effect reconciliation is required first.

Cumulative fill quantity cannot increase outside PARTIAL/FILLED; every increase requires an immutable SHA-256 fill-evidence ID and positive price. UNKNOWN/TIMED_OUT quantities are not counted as known. Complete session close is blocked while an order remains PARTIAL/WORKING/UNKNOWN or otherwise unresolved.

The read-only blotter marks accepted/working/cancel-pending/partial/timeout/unknown orders unresolved and hides fill quantity where outcome is ambiguous. Cash PaperAccount, options ledger and legacy intraday OMS adapters retain separate state models.
items.blocker: The shared order journal is integrated with ForwardSessionRunner but not yet unified transactionally across cash, options and legacy intraday books. items.text: Freeze H005 industry momentum, H003 risk-adjusted momentum and P3 frog-in-the-pan as three **separate** shadow candidates with exact original formulas, data coverage and lineage.

Fix the H003 registered universe's unintended ETF/MF inclusion only by a newly versioned and separately tested rule, never silently altering H003's prior verdict.
Require effective-dated historical index membership and delisting handling for all three; a survivorship-biased universe fails the gate.
Reproduce H005's top-three industry ranking and subsequent stock selections from strictly data available at each monthly rebalance.
Reproduce H003's 12–1 momentum divided by trailing 250-day volatility, with safe denominators and missing-history abstention.
Reproduce P3's frog-in-the-pan construction without selecting a hindsight-favorable revision; document the index/universe benchmark and turnover.
Map each book's exact holdings to purchasable equity quantities under tick, whole-share, available cash and expected charges.
Build monthly candidate generation, next-executable-session fill planning, turnover limits, cash buffers and rejected-order logs.
Regression-test the November 2026 monthly freeze caused by a missing future price; price-history errors must not freeze unrelated books.
Replay one complete monthly cycle from snapshot to equity close, including dividends, transaction taxes, DP charges and partial fills.
Track target weights, actual simulated holdings, residual cash, drift, entry/exits and actionable vs no-trade reasons.
Score each candidate against Nifty 500 TRI or a predefined genuinely matched investable universe benchmark, with matching risk/exposure/turnover controls as appropriate.
Measure strategy overlap, top-stock concentration, industry concentration, common drawdown and incremental alpha of combining them; do not count correlated momentum books as three independent edges.
Analyze 2024 weakness, recent-half and last-36-month degradation explicitly; give current data higher descriptive weight but do not re-select based on a repeatedly checked holdout.
Limit live paper capital to an owner-specified risk sleeve; model a no-trade cash outcome when available risk capital cannot cover realistic costs.
Publish a session-by-session shadow-versus-paper ledger and monthly post-cost P&L decomposition; only prospectively filled paper positions count as paper returns.
Require predeclared degradation/pause criteria, including deterioration vs benchmark, drawdown, observed cost stress and source quality, with no auto-relaxing to preserve candidate status.
Introduce one global account-risk budget across swing, intraday, ETF, options and MF sleeves; individual desk reports must reconcile to it.
Define owner-editable hard limits on daily loss, rolling drawdown, per-position risk, sector/industry allocation, underlying delta and derivatives buying power.
Compute covariance with shrinkage and guardrails for short/fat-tailed data; do not trust unstable unconstrained mean-variance weights.
Separate diversification by independent risk driver from diversification by ticker, desk name or nominal signal count.
Estimate each strategy's marginal contribution to portfolio expected return, variance, CVaR and expected drawdown under stress.
Build cash-versus-trade optimization: if no candidate survives conservative uncertainty and cost, 100% cash is a valid outcome.
Implement turnover and rebalancing budgets to prevent monthly momentum excess from being consumed by execution costs.
Model benchmark-relative beta and size/sector/factor exposures so 'alpha' cannot merely be long beta or small-cap concentration.
Cap overlapping Nifty index options positions as a single correlated exposure; prohibit independent sleeve sizing that doubles effective direction risk.
Include option greeks (delta/gamma/vega/theta), payoff convexity, expiry clustering and gap-to-stop stress in portfolio scenario analysis.
Disallow short option premium or complex multi-leg risk in a small account unless fully defined-risk, supported and explicitly authorized for paper research.
Implement a deterministic stress harness for March-2020-scale gap analogues, liquidity freezes, exchange halts and clustered exits; label scenarios as synthetic.
Compare equal-weight, risk-parity and conservative capped allocator out of sample with equal transaction-cost assumptions.
Require an incremental-selection report that demonstrates why adding each candidate improves the **portfolio** after costs and complexity.
Maintain explicit capital reserves for fees and settlement; protect against flat cash falsely appearing as tradeable buying power.
Enumerate available NSE index quote history and actually optionable underlying families by effective date; do not assume every Nifty sub-index has liquid options.
Build strict 09:15 IST session-aligned 15-minute OHLC from complete intraday feeds and prevent the currently forming bar from leaking future observations.
Define future index return distributions at 15/30/60 minutes and close, but evaluate 15-minute trading claims separately from longer-horizon statistical relevance.
Specify adaptive FLAT band derived only from training-period noise and trading-cost reality, not hand-tuned on profitable test outcomes.
Create hard baselines: random walk, class frequencies, volatility-aware no-direction, same-time-of-day climatology and a simple previous-bar rule.
Track overall three-class metrics, log loss/Brier/CRPS, directional skill, calibration per class and expected-move error; publish confidence intervals.
Include time-of-day and liquidity regime checks: first 15 minutes, midday low activity, pre-close, known macro events, expiry days and unusual option spreads.
Use only causal cross-index breadth, sector-relative changes and observed derivatives microstructure where data rights and timestamps allow.
Train simple regularized linear/logistic models and gradient-boosted baselines before optional heavier sequence models; justify added complexity with held-out gains.
Use nested chronological folds, purged overlapping forward labels and immutable train/validation/test manifests; freeze all hyperparameters before opening test.
Build a 'forecast-issued' journal at every completed interval including probabilities UP/DOWN/FLAT, timestamp, quote freshness and model SHA.
Score all forecasts including abstentions, missed intervals and days with feed outages; a missing outcome does not automatically become success.
Enforce a predictive-skill gate independent of option P&L; a direction-only model cannot be promoted on apparent option profits from optimistic fills.
Integrate an explicit market-regime/uncertainty abstention policy with diagnostics to prevent a classifier from recommending every 15 minutes.
Keep a clean no-action baseline of simply holding cash/options avoidance; do not treat 55% directional accuracy as economic evidence without payoff analysis.
Require an independently monitored prospective forecast sample before applying confidence as a sizing signal to paper option orders.
Fail closed if the model produces impossible probabilities, data lag exceeds policy, a bar is partial or published events are unavailable before the decision.
Create a canonical NFO contract ID from exchange, underlying, right, strike, expiry and effective token; refuse any guessed or delisted instrument.
Parse permitted live options-chain data: bid/ask, depth, OI, traded quantity, last trade age, implied volatility and lot size by contract.
Build volatility-surface sanity checks for strike/expiry, no-arbitrage bounds and stable estimation when quotes are wide or missing.
Implement independently tested Black–Scholes/Black-76 or suitable local pricing approximations for explanatory Greeks; price paper fills from actual quotes, never only theoretical midpoints.
Scenario-simulate option premium under underlying move, time passage, volatility change, skew shift, expiry and liquidity widening.
For a 15-minute direction prediction, compute the *premium* expected P&L distribution, not the index points multiplied by option delta alone.
Evaluate candidate CE, PE and supported defined-risk debit spreads with the same explicit fee, quote, size and no-fill constraints.
Add an executable contract ranking with selected/no-selected explanations: delta, break-even move, gamma exposure, theta, spread, depth, maximum loss and risk-capped quantity.
Reject illiquid near-expiry premium where the market spread or tail gap can exceed expected alpha, even if direction confidence is high.
Keep directional index hypothesis and option execution hypothesis as distinct signals/IDs; both require evidence, and neither inherits the other's performance score.
Implement premium-based protective stop/target/expiry exit as separate from underlying invalidation; trigger at observed tradeable quotes with partial-fill handling.
Add long-option payoff bounds: maximum invested premium loss plus transaction costs; detect capital at risk after partial fills or cancellations.
For debit spreads, model asynchronous legs, per-leg spread and no-fill; reject if portfolio could briefly become an unsupported naked short.
Compare BUY CE/PE against cash and a simple delta-equivalent exposure benchmark; choose none when expected option alpha does not clear stress.
Store rejected candidate options along with the best observed quote and future counterfactual outcome using legally permitted data, not retrospective executable claims.
Build entry/exit state for stop, target, time stop, volatility shift, signal reversal and EOD; pre-register exit rule and cost assumptions.
Measure profit per underlying-direction forecast, per option setup, expiry, delta bucket and quote-spread bucket; identify where correct direction loses money.
Conduct targeted prospective option paper sessions with precommitted contracts, bid/ask evidence, timestamps, fill probability and reconciled net P&L before any real-money readiness claim.
Keep short-premium naked selling explicitly disabled; future defined-risk credit strategies require separate contract/margin/legal review and dedicated validation.
Preserve Four-Node v1 (128 variants), v2 and v3 results as failed evidence and keep their original source and parameter snapshots immutable.

Implement a liquidity sweep with a previous confirmed high/low, threshold crossing, completed reclaim and bounded confirmation latency.
Implement five-minute and 15-minute opening range breakout with known session-open clock, close-through, buffer, volume gate and invalidation.
Implement Fibonacci levels only with causally confirmed anchors; formally test whether arbitrary extensions have value beyond generic support/resistance.
Implement continuation pullback and 20C moving-average filters with exact Wilder SMMA recurrence, lookback initialization and no-lookahead pivots.

Implement N1–N4 pivot confirmation timestamps and trade-time snapshots; chart annotations that appear later must never create earlier entries.
Build visual-audit golden fixtures for every screenshot-inspired setup: candle times, known-at overlays, entry, SL, TP and condition failures.
Compare each proposal against simple breakout, reversal and same-time random controls before introducing machine learning or multiple confirmation indicators.
Evaluate on tradable Indian equity/ETF/futures instruments first; map a surviving underlying rule into options only with a separate premium P&L study.
Count family parameter sweeps, timeframe changes, stop variants and selected screenshot examples as research looks; keep the protected trial budget.
Require walk-forward, cash/benchmark, after-cost, random-entry/null, data quality and sensitivity gates before eligibility beyond SHADOW.

Create an 'alpha hypothesis ledger' with mechanism, who trades against whom, why information is delayed/ignored, expected horizon and what would falsify it.
Prioritize independent slower-horizon research on filings/events, industry spillovers, volatility/quality, institutional behavior and changing market structure based on existing lawful feeds.
Repair release/publication timestamps for company results, insider trades, ownership disclosures, revisions, conference calls and macro events.
Validate text-extracted facts against source bytes and official disclosures; no LLM-generated accounting number enters a trading feature without provenance and deterministic checking.
Build 'market reaction already priced?' controls: opening gap, post-publication delay, overnight release, turnover shock and day-of-week benchmarks.
Compare event-driven selection against momentum overlap and matched sector/size exposures, not raw market-return drift.
Investigate high-cost avoid-filters separately from equity alpha and from operational risk filters; report if excluding names changes turnover and fees more than returns.
Build event-to-trade simulator accounting for detection delay, source publication, broker arrival, exchange opening and unavailable after-hours execution.
Explicitly handle disclosure coverage gaps and missing older history; do not backfill derived news sentiment with modern sources and claim point-in-time availability.
Use the existing knowledge graph as a research feature only when edges are dated, typed and auditable, not as a free-form LLM trading signal.
Test residualized factors that target independent excess beyond momentum/low volatility; retain the residual signal's reduced effect honestly.
Quantify opportunity frequency and market capacity before building complex models; a statistically detectable event with negligible executable volume is not a product.
Require out-of-sample replication across market phases, instrument sizes and data acquisition paths before allocating even paper capital.
Introduce an annualized research-budget ledger with per-family attention costs and a hard stop on redundant 1-minute/indicator combinations.
Favor improving decision abstention, allocation and execution of a real signal over attempting to force 25 independent strategies to exist.
Keep an explicit `NO_REPLICABLE_ALPHA_FOUND` outcome; no optimization objective is allowed to rewrite this into a favorable verdict.
Require fixed initial owner-defined capital, risk-per-trade, daily/weekly/monthly max drawdown, max contract exposure and maximum acceptable slippage in a signed policy.

Model option Greeks and tail gap loss at portfolio level; account for same-underlying multi-leg concentration and correlated settlement risk.
Use volatility-aware position sizing with severe shrinkage toward zero when probabilities are uncalibrated or recent evidence weakens.
Restrict Kelly-like sizing to audited forward net outcomes, conservative shrinkage and hard fraction caps; never infer optimal size from in-sample win rate.
Add order count, order value, turnover, failed execution, stale-data and account-loss brakes independent of strategy signal generation.
Automatically abstain on known unusable exchange states, unlicensed data, missing underlying, invalid option contract, stale quotes and uncertain open exposure.
Simulate slippage tail events where stop fills far beyond intended level and margin depletion may be larger than initial quoted stop risk.
Add crash-safe kill switches for broker and paper engines, with external owner reset required after risk breach; AI recommendations cannot override a halt.
Detect performance drift using calibrated rolling metrics and sequential monitoring that controls false alarms from repeated peeking.
Define a first-loss incident postmortem workflow: preserve raw quote, signal, risk, execution and ledger hashes before any attempted repair.
Ensure rejected and stopped strategies retain outcome evidence for postmortem and retraining without turning rejected fills into observed market fills.
Test historical stress years, option spread blowouts, settlement events, split errors, mass data outages and platform/clock failures independently.
Run property-based simulation of thousands of trades ensuring total reserved and at-risk capital never exceeds signed hard limits.
Maintain multiple distinct risk declarations: forecast uncertainty, execution uncertainty, liquidity risk, market gap risk and operational position-state uncertainty.
Establish separate SHADOW and LIVE_PAPER cohorts with different IDs, policy hashes, execution assets and capital; disallow hindsight promotion of a shadow result into prospective execution evidence.
Check legal scope of real-time data paper trading before prospective live paper capture; if not permitted, stay in delayed/replay evidence and say forward executable testing is blocked.
Lock exact strategy code, parameters, universe, signal interval, costs, risk and benchmark before each prospective session starts.
Write append-only local intent/decision/quote/outcome records with source clocks and SHA-linked previous event; treat local hashes as tamper-evident only, not independent proof.
Use independent third-party custody/timestamp receipts only when legally available, else label evidence `LOCAL_ONLY`, never fabricated `ATTESTED`.
Preserve every interval's recommendation including NO_TRADE, rejected contract, skipped rebalance and missing data; zero trades is not a profitable trading day.
Keep true session return series including zero-return cash days and partial positions; never filter the P&L sample down to profitable sessions.
Require every candidate to publish its expected-value forecast **before** the execution clock and record changes as new versions, not retroactive annotation.
Persist real quote bid/ask and execution-data availability at decision and exit when rights permit; no closing price fallback can claim execution.
Automate day-end reconciliations of orders, positions, cash, open risk, fees and marked equity; seal a run only after all exceptions are resolved.
Maintain a separate unresolved-exposure journal: stale price, missing exit, no confirmable quote and broker/fill ambiguity are adverse evidence, not zero-loss exceptions.
Add shock drills with feed loss, process restart, system clock skew, option expiry, canceled orders and unmapped tokens during a paper session.
Create an independent daily reporting job that verifies all decisions and quote lineage from raw logs, without importing research/backtest targets.
Generate one-page session proof with eligible count, generated signals, blocked signals, matched fills, missing fills, gross/net P&L, worst loss and benchmark comparison.
Keep portfolio performance and evidence separated by asset class, strategy, origin (manual/automatic), forward regime and realized versus valuation components.
Reproduce the entire session and compare deterministic event hashes to original run, including abstentions and unknown outcomes; fail on material mismatch.
Require sequential evidence windows specified in advance; do not stop and declare success on a lucky streak while continuing to test after losses.

Set trading-day operational checks that are measurable without profits: zero unaccounted open orders, zero unsupported fills, zero unauthorized broker calls, source freshness pass and complete outputs.
Create a release-blocking `forward_evidence_gate` that remains RED until all specified clean future sessions, attribution and benchmark superiority are genuinely observed.
Calculate actual filled-trade P&L from entry proceeds, closing proceeds, commissions, spreads, funding and other appropriate charges, with a separate tax-estimate view.
Reconcile closed trade outcomes and still-open mark-to-market risk into ending account equity; do not sum only winners or ignore partial exits.
Attribute returns to market beta, industry, style, selection, timing, position size, regime, option premium effects, liquidity and execution quality.
Decompose options P&L by underlying movement, delta/gamma approximations, theta decay, implied-volatility change and residual bid/ask execution.
Separate predicted index UP/DOWN/FLAT accuracy from whether the option position actually generated positive net premium return.
Compare strategy to matching benchmark with exposure, sector, leverage and turnover controls; raw absolute profit in a bull market does not establish alpha.
Decompose slippage relative to decision mid, executable touch, arrival quote and observed paper-fill model, disclosing which reference points are hypothetical.
Build accepted-vs-rejected candidate counterfactuals only where comparable observation data exists; label those valuations as estimates, not executable fills.
Track turnover, net basis points per trade, drawdown duration, worst day/week/month, loss clustering, tail loss, Sharpe/Sortino, exposure and capacity.
Compute per-trade expectancy and break-even win probability given actual win/loss distribution and all costs; no universal '60% win rate' target.
Report realized versus unrealized P&L and available cash, then month-to-date and cumulative performance with contributions by strategy/desk/instrument.
Create a model confidence calibration report by regime and time of day; a 70% probability bin must be empirically checked on unseen observations.
Measure marginal contribution of each signal/confirmation filter through predeclared ablation and equal-cost nulls, counting all research looks.
Score approval/discretion separately: owner overrides vs default model under identical point-in-time information and capital budget.
Implement trade-level loss review containing data, model, contract choice, execution, exit and sizing root cause; no narrative without source references.
Export a tamper-evident account report that distinguishes research, paper-fills, hypothetical scenarios, and broker-verified activity.
Regress net results on cost multipliers and market exposure; flag any 'profit' depending solely on optimistic fills or extraordinary beta.
Build a five-desk dashboard with source SHA, live/fixture label, newest quote age, risk policy, holdings, free cash, daily and historical results.
Implement a synchronized Nifty direction grid with p(UP)/p(DOWN)/p(FLAT), expected range, model validity and forecast-vs-actual calibration status.
Add explicit `BUY`, `SELL_TO_CLOSE`, `BUY_TO_COVER`, `HOLD`, `WATCH`, `NO_TRADE`, `REJECTED`, `UNRESOLVED` states instead of conflating forecast with order.
Display real contract identity, expiry, strike, right, lot, bid/ask source, decision time and quote age next to every CE/PE proposal.
Display SL and TP as *policy triggers* and subsequently observed actual exits as distinct fields; a stop label never implies an executable exit price.
Show per-trade ex-ante expected costs, fee uncertainty, stop distance, quantity and blocked reason; make `NO_TRADE` a first-class visible result.
Provide per-strategy and per-desk gross P&L, fee leakage, net P&L, risk-adjusted benchmark excess and independent evidence tier.
Show a red operational banner for missing exits, unresolved positions, stale quotes, stale rebalance, missing data permissions and failing CI.
Expose immutable signal-to-order-to-fill-to-exit drill-down with traceability hashes and one-click comparison to exact past snapshot.
Implement conservative alerts for newly generated eligible signals, existing-position SL/TP triggers, risk/kill-switch state changes and data-health failures.
Include a research-hypothesis board with strategy version, historical verdict, forward tier, prior failed variants and reasons for non-promotion.
Build a simple operator replay mode for a specific session that animates decisions without showing candles that were not yet known at that instant.
Use usability tests with false-positive BUY and stale-option-quote cases; an operator must correctly distinguish recommendation from executable position.
Add test fixtures for same-bar SL+TP, gap-through-stop, no exchange liquidity, partial option fills, closing quote older than the stop trigger and market halt.
Build clock-leakage tests for 1m/5m/15m/futures/options/MF data, all with publication-time and available-at mutations.
Test corporate action and index membership lookahead using historical ticker/ISIN changes, delisted symbols and revised filings.
Fuzz options chain contract identity, negative/zero bid, crossed quotes, infinity/NaN Greeks, expired token, wrong lot size and wrong option right.
Run property-based accounting tests for cash, units, gross/net book, charge conservation, dividend, split, option settlement and partial exits.
Simulate state-machine crashes before/after every durable write, after quote but before intent, before/after fill and during ledger reconciliation.
Test all loss-limit gates under concurrent desk decisions; ensure a risk block cannot be overridden by the UI, agent, broker adapter or reentrant event.
Reproduce monthly-book November freeze, 51 missing exits, source-inventory CRLF issue, F13/F17 regression and nonmonotonic events as permanent regression tests.
Include quote-feed outage and recovery scenarios with a position that remains open: stale valuation must not be converted into a fabricated closed fill.
Add an explicit no-broker-write test intercepting network and all order client functions; every intended paper trade must remain local.
Run strategy acceptance with surrogate labels and permuted returns to prove the pipeline does not 'discover' strong alpha from random noise.
Verify candidate confidence calibration and economic expectancy independently with known randomized experiments and fixed seeds.
Ensure no strategy promotion on validation-only datasets, training-only holdout, post-hoc prior assignments or false 'independent' custody labels.
Maintain clean Linux and Windows CI, reproducible dependencies, isolated DB fixtures and source hashing with coverage targets for critical financial invariants.
Run differential tests between historical replayer and live event stream for identical ordered inputs, requiring identical strategy decisions and risk rejections.
Include performance/load tests for simultaneous 15-minute index forecasts, options chain evaluation and protective exits while the broker interface is denied.
Maintain an incident classification and fix-or-disable policy; a new unresolved monetary invariant blocks release regardless of green strategy metrics.
Require tests, docs and an executable acceptance artifact per checklist item; no checkbox may be marked DONE solely because a module exists.
Provide reproducible Windows and Linux installations from an audited lockfile with zero user-specific hard-coded paths.
Configure one local scheduler for exchange-aware daily preflight, 15-minute forecasts, protective exit monitoring, monthly rebalances and day-end reports.
Implement encrypted credential storage and secret scanning; remove broker API secrets from logs, diagnostics, export files and screenshots.
Bind live paper datasource entitlements and permitted retention to an explicit source policy and audit trail; reject unapproved live mock usage.
Add backup, encrypted ledger export, point-in-time restore, disaster recovery and independent verification of account balances after restore.
Publish strategy and account kill-switch conditions in a read-only ops runbook; make failures and degraded modes obvious to operators.
Require the real-market/live broker path to stay unavailable in all shipping artifacts for this phase, regardless of configuration toggles.
Implement an **offline** broker dry-run verifier for order idempotency, pretrade compliance, margin preflight and required approval without any network order write.
Identify current Indian exchange/broker/SEBI rules for retail automated orders and provider data use from official sources before contemplating an actual broker connection.
Require independent written provider answers about quote retention, live paper use and derivatives-data permissions; do not claim an all-in-house replacement for licensed data.
Require explicit human approval, capital source, loss limits, freeze windows and exit emergency procedures separately from the algorithm's validation score.
If cash trading is later authorized, start with the smallest practical legal brokerage lot/position and a human-approved ticket stage; avoid naked option writing and unsafe leverage.
Maintain an independent broker post-trade reconciler for any later live account, and refuse resend after unknown acknowledgement until order status is verified.
Implement staged rollback and transaction-cancel safety; changing a paper strategy cannot silently mutate a live-account release.
Maintain public-facing claim labels so users never mistake a backtested forecast, a local paper result and real broker profit for equivalent evidence.
Disallow production launch if any data-rights, compliance, liquidity, cash/positions, unresolved orders or forward-evidence gate is red.

Define a minimum acceptable economic outcome **before** prospective observation: positive portfolio net excess after execution costs with a dependence-aware lower uncertainty bound above zero or another justified predeclared threshold.

Define the benchmark per desk and horizon: matched equities TRI, cash/short-term safe benchmark, ETF benchmark or an honest options risk/capital alternative; never use one benchmark for incompatible assets.
Define a minimum number of independent *sessions or rebalance periods*, not just an inflated count of overlapping 15-minute bars or highly correlated trades.
Lock risk acceptance in advance: maximum peak-to-trough loss, worst scenario loss, operational error tolerance, concentration, quote delay and exposure limits.
Require net excess survives optimistic/base/adverse fee and execution-cost models; if it wins only under optimistic midprice fills, mark FAIL.
Require the selected candidate improves on a simple, implementable baseline with comparable cash allocation, turnover, beta, factor tilt and risk; otherwise no new capital is warranted.
Require no unclosed/unresolved economic exposures, cash mismatches, fabricated closes, unknown order outcomes or missing broker permissions as part of the profit score.
Evaluate out-of-sample calibration for forecasts separately from actual option premium P&L; false confidence must reduce position sizes and trigger abstention.
Compare profit across market regimes and independent calendar blocks; a gain concentrated in one event or one day is insufficient.
Publish raw equity series, all fee lines, all trades, rejected opportunities, open marks, dated data-source access and source hashes for reproducibility.
Create a 'decision audit' explaining why the same candidate would or would not be recommended with only data available at that exact time.
Classify each family as `REJECTED`, `SHADOW`, `PAPER_UNPROVEN`, `PAPER_PROMISING`, `PAPER_CONFIRMED`, `CASH_REVIEW_ONLY`, or `BROKER_APPROVAL_ELIGIBLE` using frozen gates.
Make `NO_PROFITABLE_STRATEGY_FOUND` a valid release output; system reliability may reach 10/10 while economic alpha is absent.
Require forward degradation monitoring after initial success, with rollback and deallocation if net value disappears; do not freeze a historical profitable label permanently.
Produce a final owner-facing economic report: what made money, when, why, how much was lost, how robust results are and why actual cash remains gated.
Capture `main` SHA, dependencies, data versions, active scheduled checkout, CI jobs and current owner approvals into an immutable baseline manifest.

items.text: Create canonical `FeatureDefinition` with formula hash, window, market, horizon, input lineage, lag, leakage tests and data type.
Implement streaming OHLCV aggregation for 1m/5m/15m/30m/1h/day with missing-minute flags and completed-bar semantics.
Add price-return, volatility, range, trend, volume participation, gap, session VWAP, breadth and liquidity as separate causal feature families.
Add options IV surface, skew, term structure, Greeks and OI features only where observed quotes/contracts support estimation.
Construct cross-index breadth, constituent concentration, Nifty/BankNifty co-movement and sector relative-strength features with aligned timestamps.
Extract event-availability indicators for NSE/BSE filings, corporate announcements, results, shareholding and financial statement revisions.
Implement cross-sectional sector, size, liquidity, beta and corporate-action neutralization fitted on past samples only.
Keep raw, adjusted and total-return price series separated; enforce dividend and split correctness by arithmetic reconciliation.
Add `FeatureSnapshot` with observation/availability timestamp, feature version, source hashes and missingness masks.
Guard against stale indicator values, forward-filled expired contracts and all market-close-to-open boundary leakage.
Create streaming/offline parity fixtures: same market event prefix must produce same feature values in replay and forward processing.
Apply schema migrations with checksummed transformations and automatic feature lineage invalidation when raw source corrections arrive.
Measure feature stability by date, instrument, regime and provider; surface feature drift before automatic retraining.
Detect proxy leakage (index weights inferred from revised constituents, event timestamps after publication, synthetic corporate-action adjustment).
Store exclusion reasons and instrument eligibility at each timestamp so the learner can model genuine no-trade opportunities.
Make feature computation idempotent and deterministic under out-of-order, duplicate and corrected input events.
Benchmark feature inference latency and memory on realistic multi-index and liquid-stock universes.
Force each learned policy to emit all feature IDs and their availability proof in its decision manifest.
Implement `ResearchAgent`, `HypothesisGenerator`, `ExperimentExecutor`, `Evaluator`, `PolicyRegistry`, `RiskGovernor`, `PaperOperator`, `Auditor` interfaces.
Use one event-sourced learning state machine: `HYPOTHESIS → REGISTERED → TRAINED → OOS_TESTED → SHADOW → FORWARD_CANDIDATE → REVIEWED → RETIRED`.
Keep immutable trial identity over family, instrument universe, horizon, dataset version, feature set, action space, reward, code SHA and cost model.
Separate learning-state writes from portfolio-state writes; research agents must not change cash, fills, ledger balances or release policy.
Model all strategy recommendations as `PROPOSE`, `WATCH`, `NO_TRADE`, `EXIT_PROPOSAL`; ownership gates decide eligibility.
Create reason-coded rejection paths for insufficient sample, leakage, stale data, missing rights, excessive cost and unsafe action.
Expose `PolicyDecision` with probabilities, expected net excess, uncertainty, capacity, risk budget, provenance and available-at clock.
Add freeze windows: retraining cannot mutate currently deployed policy weights, state definitions or reward functions during a session.
Declare learning budgets: CPU/GPU/time/disk/trial counts; budget exhaustion must stop research automatically.
Build human-only permission checks for changing statistical thresholds, capital caps, strategy families, broker flags or protected holdouts.
Create structured machine-readable experiment reports and human-readable economic rationale, with no success claims from test count.
Implement data/reward/protocol contracts as schemas with Pydantic or pure typed validators, pinned by hashes.
Declare deterministic simulation mode and probabilistic training mode with seed registers and reproducibility reports.
Integrate with existing `forward_edge/` claim tiers and ADRs via adapters; no parallel, less strict promotion path.
Implement familywise lineage: descendants share parent discovery-trial budget and cannot reset failure history by renaming.
Include policy abstention and market-close actions in every decision API; forbid forced trades.
Develop kill-switch and audited manual intervention paths that work even if all learning services are unavailable.
Define outcome statuses `FAIL`, `NO_EDGE`, `CANDIDATE`, `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE`, `PAPER_CONFIRMED`, never fabricate evidence.
Model the task as a partially observable sequential decision process, not a fully known future price trajectory.

Assign every feature and candidate to an economic hypothesis: risk premium, liquidity, behavioral delay, structural demand, event timing or market microstructure.
Require a mechanism statement, predicted direction, horizon, failure regime and falsifying test before candidate construction.
Create AST-based program representation and safe interpreter with bounded expression size, no arbitrary Python, no network and no data mutation.
Expose allowed primitives: rolling rank, decile, lag, volatility, relative-strength, sector neutralization, event age and cross-sectional group.
Add declarative constraints to prohibit future references, invalid implicit joins, lookahead pivots and calendar offsets beyond available data.
Implement algebraic and semantic canonicalization so duplicate strategies share trial identity even if expressions differ syntactically.
Add family similarity clustering by input features, behavior, trades, sector and realized P&L; do not count cloned alphas as independent.
Create static cost upper-bound estimator and minimum tradable-horizon check to reject impossible high-turnover concepts early.
Generate a baseline/null hypothesis paired with every new candidate before any return series is computed.
Define event hypotheses against publication timestamp, not fiscal quarter label or later revised filing.
Define long, short, cash, hedge and options hypotheses with market authorization and paper-specific masks.
Implement crossover/noise/metamorphic tests: future mutation, time reversal, shuffled labels, lagged features and random signs.
Add structural complexity cap, logic-depth cap and portfolio turnover budget; disallow unconstrained genetic-code explosion.
Store raw researcher prompt, generated AST, parent IDs, generated code SHA, economic rationale and cost estimate in append-only manifests.
Detect invalid redundant filters (combining highly correlated momentum transforms) and report effective number of economic ideas.

Use self-generated candidates and stored literature notes strictly as proposals, never as evidence that a return exists.

Cap candidate generation per family and prevent agent from silently increasing search budgets after failed outcomes.

Separate new information sources from new transforms of identical candle patterns; record whether marginal information actually exists.
Create candidate comparison against matched random-book, time-shifted signal, sector-neutral and equal-turnover controls.

Create candidate-level alternative explanations and a checklist for corporate-action/adjusted-price artifacts.

items.text: Assign nonoverlapping roles: macro/market researcher, data auditor, statistical reviewer, execution engineer, risk critic and experiment registrar.
Create evidence graph from hypothesis → inputs → model → backtest → critiques → outcomes → promotion decision.
Build immutable decision memory for each agent with versioned model state, known data as-of, contradictions and uncertainty.
Store postmortems for Four-Node, indicator-only intraday, VWAP and other failed strategy families to prevent rediscovery loops.
Implement failure-taxonomy learning: leakage, impossible fill, fees, missing rights, invalid null, overfit, low power, market regime shift.
Use independent critic prompts/rules for economic mechanisms, causal correctness, code safety, and mathematical evaluation.
Keep independent reviewer from reading candidate author's private training result labels when reviewing protocol.
Develop disagreement escalation to human review or `HOLD`, never average unsafe proposals into an approved trade.
Create exact reproducibility packet for accepted and rejected hypotheses with model checkpoint and raw source snapshots.
Implement cross-project separation: no investing/finance agent uses unrelated personal secrets as trading features.
Make memory updates append-only with correction records, not mutable narratives that change prior evidence.
Enable automated literature comparison via safely obtained public references; literature popularity does not confer alpha.
Publish critique coverage: number of detected defects by source family and false approval rate on injected cheating examples.
Create human-readable causal evidence report distinguishing backtest association from observed economic mechanism.
Detect and flag majority-vote hallucination: five agents agreeing without any additional market data remains zero empirical evidence.
Create privacy/security controls for financial account holdings and broker credentials in logs and agent prompts.
Implement source rights separation for proprietary reports and model weights; no covert redistribution.
Preserve a historical audit of what each agent believed before seeing outcomes for prospective assessment.
Build Learning Control Room separate from trader order UI, with clear RESEARCH/SHADOW/PAPER/REAL labels.
Display candidate funnel counts by created, registered, tested, failed, shadowed, forward-reviewed and retired.
Show champion/challenger paired cumulative net excess, drawdown, costs, turnover and uncertainty intervals.
Display reward decomposition and count of unresolved orders before any profit headline.
Expose 15-minute Nifty forecast probabilities and calibration separately from option CE/PE decisions and premium P&L.
Provide per-asset-class ledger, instrument exposure, capital reserved and available cash, including pending MF states.
Create confidence and evidence-tier badges that cannot be set by a strategy author or free-text agent response.
Show performance by regime, sector, liquidity, month, holding horizon and capital size with adequate sample warnings.
Display date of latest valid market quote, paper run completion, strategy version, feature freshness and source entitlement.
Provide an Explain Decision panel: all alternatives, expected net alpha, why no trade, invalidation, SL/TP and required approvals.
Build failure analysis browser for historical candidate loss decomposition and false positive root causes.
Provide owner-only controls to halt paper sessions, lower risk, freeze retraining, mark evidence invalid or retire a policy.
Require explicit review for any action that would increase size, leverage or exposure; prohibit hidden auto-approval.
Add trustworthy stale-data/offline-state UI, and prevent the screen from displaying last quote as current executable market.
Build daily/monthly research digest showing candidates discovered, real results, costs, operational defects and loss-limit state.
Provide exportable JSON/CSV/HTML/PDF-compatible scorecards from the same source-of-truth ledger with versioned report IDs.
Add user journey tests to distinguish a research suggestion from an actionable, approved instrument-specific signal.
Measure utility by false trade recommendations prevented, reproducible evaluations and correct abstention, not dashboard activity.
Create market-session preflight validating clock, quotes, licensed feed permissions, source metadata, open positions and kill switch.
Write planned cohort registration and policy hash before any real market event reaches research evaluation.
Collect new quote/order/decision sequences with source/receive timestamps and permitted retention into append-only stores.
Attach evidence tier `LOCAL_PAPER`, `INDEPENDENT_FORWARD` only when separately verified custody actually exists.
Record every opportunity rejected for risk, cost, insufficient confidence, stale data and no-trade choices.
Run H005/H003/P3 champion and learner shadow cohorts with shared eligible universe and matched capital/economics.
Run Nifty 15-minute forecaster in forecast-only shadow until direction calibration and net options decision validity pass.
Monitor positions and precommitted exit rules continuously within permitted feed and session constraints.
Persist intent before simulated execution, order state and fills before portfolio mutation, and post exactly-once fees.
On feed outage, mark position OPEN/UNRESOLVED or defensibly marked; stale last quote is not a completed executable SELL.
Implement recovery from process kill at any event boundary without duplicate fill, duplicate reward or lost stop obligation.
Run end-of-day cash/position/fee/quantity/collateral reconciliation and produce a signed-or-hashed session report.
Keep raw source event path and derived strategy judgment separately for independent replay and consistency checks.
Include at least one all-cash session in validation and require no fictitious orders or success-rate manipulation.
Store mark-to-market of open positions, pending orders and external flows across monthly boundaries.
Build independent performance statistic jobs that never share or depend on agent-reported reward summaries.
Handle scheduled market holidays, exchange disruption and options expiry correctly with visible session status.
Enforce no direct order permission for agents/learners, including loss recovery or emergency override.
Publish cumulative cohort-level returns net of all supported costs and benchmark, including missed/cancelled fills.
Retain independently reviewable evidence that timestamps, quotes, actions, fills and scorecards were generated in that order.
Define policy decision as advice until a separately trusted broker-side approval component authorizes an order.
Implement hard-coded `PHYSICAL_ORDERS_ENABLED=false` in current learning execution stack with hostile network tests.
Create independent human-signed approvals for any future broker stage, account, capital, asset classes and permission expiration.
Keep broker keys out of research agents, generated code, experiment logs, dashboard JS and training datasets.
Implement principle-of-least-privilege connectors for read-only market data versus portfolio observation versus restricted future order path.
Check license/retention permissions for data in simulation, learning and forward paper mode before first read.
Test source manipulation, forged ticks, replayed quotes, reordered event timestamps and intentional stale feed responses.
Prevent runtime code generation, untrusted deserialization, subprocess escape and arbitrary model checkpoint execution.
Check weights/artifact provenance and cryptographic hashes before loading an active model.
Implement audit of dependencies, dynamic imports, model checkpoint integrity and CI provenance.
Build risk governor as non-ML deterministic independently tested module that can halt all strategies.
Enforce daily/session/account loss limits and position exposure across every desk with fail-closed handling.
Log every risk-cap and model version change with identity, justification, approval and earliest effective time.
Add adversarial prompt tests using malicious filing/news text asking agent to disable risk checks or output fake profit.
Run simulation of rogue researcher producing thousands of near-identical variants to launder a false positive.
Ensure execution cannot activate from label alone; confidence, reward or human-friendly prose never equals permission.
Declare real-money readiness dependent on up-to-date market/broker rules and human legal review, not completion of software tasks.
Provide emergency operation manual for stale feed, corrupt ledger, wrong contract, unauthorized order, position mismatch and active drawdown.
Build reproducible local Python 3.13/NumPy/Pandas/DuckDB environment and optional PyTorch training extra with locked versions.
Provide CPU baseline learners capable of running on a 16GB RAM development machine with deterministic partitions.
Use partitioned Parquet and memory-mapped datasets to avoid loading the full market tape into RAM.
Implement streaming minibatches, sequence sharding and asynchronous prefetch only if deterministic sample-order metadata is retained.
Add GPU optionality for offline RL neural models; never make the system depend on rented external intelligence APIs.
Use single host lock and scheduler to prevent two learner processes mutating the same candidate/ledger.
Checkpoint weights, optimizer, RNG, scheduler, progress, data version and training metrics atomically.
Implement resumable training with exact parent checkpoint and byte-for-byte or tolerance-verified continuation.
Create compute budgets for train/validate/falsify/candidate search, with automatic early-stop on failure.
Profile cost per candidate and marginal information improvement relative to simpler features.
Build model compression/distillation only after economic OOS results show a substantial advantage.
Run strict CI for learning library: unit, numerical gradient, toy-env, deterministic training, OOD, data leakage and policy comparison tests.
Create reproducible benchmark tasks from synthetic markets with analytic optimal decisions and known zero-alpha controls.
Compare training speed, policy evaluation cost, cold-start latency and peak memory by algorithm/horizon.
Add `--dry-run`, `--fixture-only`, `--offline`, `--shadow` and `--resume` flags with fail-closed defaults.
Keep scheduler from causing order or model updates at market opens if preflight incomplete.
Build machine-readable candidate manifests for exact rerun on Windows and Linux and standardized result archive.
Create hardware performance report; no new accelerator purchase required until its bottleneck is quantified.
Test positive-control deterministic market with known profitable policy recovers correct action without lookahead.
Test fair random-walk market with positive costs yields no validated systematic trading edge.
Test learned Q overestimation from unsupported actions causes fallback and candidate rejection.
Test zero bid/ask depth, quote outage and spread widening cannot be represented as executable fills.
Test reward does not improve if loser positions are left unmarked or hidden from ledger.
Test delayed option expiry and monthly reward attribution: model cannot train on not-yet-observed P&L.
Test all future data mutated after t has no impact on prior features, decisions or model updates.
Test symbol changes, delisting, dividends, splits and expiring option tokens maintain correct historical identity.
Test same-bar SL/TP conflict uses adverse-first or unresolved, never favorable hindsight ordering.
Test different session time zones, market holidays and partial candles do not generate phantom signals.
Test random candidate search of thousands of fake rules does not yield unadjusted promoted false edge.
Test self-competition: independent evaluator and registry reject model that author edits after holdout results.
Test OPE when behavior action propensities are missing, tiny or zero; output unsupported not fake significance.
Test all-cash policy has exactly zero trade fees and every cash day is included in returns.
Test negative benchmark alpha despite positive raw P&L remains a failure when benchmark-relative claim is made.
Test offline sample density shift and unsupported high-leverage action cannot trigger an approved order.
Test retry after crash at journal boundaries causes no duplicate cash movement, position, fill or learning reward.
Test multimodel correlated strategy picks cannot violate global capital and tail-risk limits.
Test permission denial for data sources and broker sends cannot be bypassed by generated code, prompt injections or model weights.
Test rollback reinstates champion and accounts for pending simulated positions without changing their entry history.
Test every research result produces exact reproducible input manifests and raw independent economic evaluator output.
Include mutation testing and coverage targets for numerical methods, risk gates, OMS, strategy identity and evaluation honesty.
Build `fb learn audit` read-only baseline checker and refuse active release on missing source, CI, right or ledger gate.
Build `fb learn discover --family ... --budget ...` producing proposals/registered manifests, not physical trades.
Build `fb learn train --policy ... --mode offline` creating immutable checkpoints and train/validation scorecards.
Build `fb learn evaluate --candidate ... --protocol ...` recomputing outcomes from ledger with selection correction.
Build `fb learn falsify --candidate ...` applying nulls, shuffled signals, cost stress, capacity and causal leakage tests.
Build `fb learn shadow --candidate ...` consuming only permitted market observations and appending decisions prospectively.
Build `fb learn compare --champion ... --challenger ...` producing paired-session, matched-capital net economics.
Build `fb learn propose-promotion --candidate ...` outputting full blockers and requesting human review; it never promotes directly.
Build `fb learn monitor --desk all` displaying data, feature, model, economic and execution degradation without mutating strategy.
Build `fb learn rollback --policy ...` authorized safety fallback with immutable event log.
Implement end-to-end fixture campaign: auto-propose → register → train → falsify → shadow → reject known bad strategy.
Implement synthetic positive-control fixture that passes only with genuinely causal advantage and realistic cost accounting.
Run matched historical OOS of H005/H003/P3 selector with frozen methodology, logging all candidate versions.
Run Nifty 15-minute forecast-only shadow cohort; permit option paper proposals only if real quote/license gates pass.
Run independent safety drill for stale quote, feed outage, wrong expiry, open position at shutdown and crash recovery.
Create complete strategy/model documentation, API schemas, SQL migrations, operation runbooks and developer handoff.
Produce final artifact manifest of current code, datasets, active policies, evidence tier, net P&L, drawdowns and unresolved blockers.
Define success even when results fail: deterministic research pipeline, measurable rejection, no unauthorized action and honest `NO_EDGE_FOUND`.
Gate `LEARNING_PLATFORM_COMPLETE` on implementation and tests; gate `PAPER_EDGE_CONFIRMED` separately on fresh independent evidence.
Declare all LIVE_CASH pathways closed until explicit human owner authorization, broker acceptance, licensing and independently reviewed risk.
Freeze strategy family, universe, benchmark, decision clock, capital, cost model, testing horizon and acceptable risk *before* future observations.
Define monthly equity-momentum and 15-minute options evidence windows separately; overlapping trades or bars are not independent sessions.
Count real observed net account equity by chronological evaluation period, including cash, idle days and current open-risk marks.
Compute benchmark-adjusted return after fees/taxes where applicable and compare with simple matched-capital policies.
Require independently reviewed or robustly reconstructed fill/cost evidence; disallow positive results based solely on synthetic proxy fills.
Require dependence-aware confidence interval and appropriate null/multiple-testing gates from existing accepted research protocol.
Conduct positive and negative control checks, regime splits, capacity stress and sensitivity to changing quote/cost assumptions.
Assess profitability after honest drawdown, CVaR and risk-limit breach accounting; never trade through breached safety constraints.
Compute evidence quality and sample sufficiency; return `INSUFFICIENT` rather than declaring profit from several lucky weeks.
Require operational completeness: no unresolved position, duplicate order, stale-as-executable close, missing fee or unlicensed data used in claim.
Perform independent review of repeated adaptive model revisions, online selection looks and re-registration to avoid double spending holdouts.
Declare `NO_CONFIRMED_EDGE` when positive training reward fails prospective economic gates; the platform may still be engineering-complete.
Preserve unchanged champion as baseline until a challenger wins a prospectively predeclared comparison.
Measure incremental value from discovery, selection, position sizing, execution timing and risk separately with ablation cohorts.
Create reporting that clearly separates historical hypothetical, fresh local paper, independently attested forward and real brokerage outcomes.
Define real-money pilot limits by owner approval, legal permissions, broker constraints and explicit stop/rollback; no automatic capital scaling.
Forbid transferring position-size gains from synthetic/low-cost conditions directly to real funded capital.
Implement operational de-escalation to CASH and independent owner alert on live loss-limit, data or custody breach.
Require a new evidence gate after each material strategy change; no perpetual profitable certification.
Publish final signed review with explicit answer: what made money, when, relative to what, at what risk/cost, and how reliable is the evidence.

assessment_summary.evidence_update: FB-0713 COMPLETE in paper-book scope: explicit folio identity now controls lot creation, redemption capacity, accepted unit-redemption orders, cashless systematic flows, valuation display and multi-folio reinvestment. Legacy lots remain unassigned until an operator records hash-pinned ownership evidence; that evidence is not independently verified against a registrar. Nine MF lifecycle/migration suites passed (58 tests), with Ruff, targeted mypy, terminal checks and generated architecture inventory checks passing. FB-0501 is now PARTIAL: fixed-horizon comparable-ETF momentum candidate implemented and contract-tested, but not performance-evaluated; research authorization, costs, capacity, and prospective evidence remain required. Evidence pointers reconciled to the latest implementation commits for FB-0103, FB-0105 and FB-0501. ETF momentum v1.1.0 now also requires close availability at or before as_of, endpoint source hashes, and an ordered unique sourced-session calendar; performance evaluation remains unauthorized/pending. FB-1104 is now PARTIAL: a durable, candidate-hash-bound human paper decision journal exists; user interaction and runner/book integration are still missing. FB-1104 now includes the fb paper-decision local CLI capture path, still without cockpit or runner/book integration. FB-0502 is PARTIAL: pre-registered ETF trend, moving-average, medium-horizon mean-reversion and volatility-sizing candidates are implemented and contract-tested; research evaluation is not authorized and no profitability claim is made. FB-0503 is PARTIAL: a frozen equity/debt/gold/silver rotation candidate and inverse-volatility, buy-and-hold, same-risk, and cash controls are implemented; performance evaluation remains unauthorized. FB-0504 is PARTIAL: a point-in-time ETF opening-range candidate is gated by observed spread, top depth, liquidity, and cost proxy; full quoted spread is used for round-trip spread cost.
